# watchpoint_mail_monitor (Resource)

A mail server monitor: connects over SMTP, IMAP or POP3 (plain, STARTTLS or implicit TLS), optionally logs in, and asserts on the banner and response time. Requires the `mail_monitors` feature. Hosted locations only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Check that the SMTP relay answers, negotiates STARTTLS and accepts a login.
resource "watchpoint_mail_monitor" "relay" {
  name                     = "SMTP relay"
  host                     = "smtp.example.com"
  port                     = 587
  protocol                 = "Smtp"
  tls_mode                 = "StartTls"
  username                 = "monitor@example.com"
  password                 = "{{vault.SMTP_MONITOR_PASSWORD}}"
  expected_banner_contains = "ESMTP"
  max_response_time_ms     = 3000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Mail server host name or IP.
- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name; shown across the UI and alerts.

### Optional

- `alert_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls notification channels and routing.
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Plans cap the minimum.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment the monitor belongs to (a `watchpoint_environment` id). When omitted, a new monitor joins the tenant's default environment and an existing one keeps its environment. Reads return the effective environment, so a monitor that follows the default shows the default's id.
- `expected_banner_contains` (String) Substring the server greeting must contain.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group this monitor belongs to.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls which regions run the check. Hosted regions only: private locations refuse this monitor type.
- `max_response_time_ms` (Number) Fail when the exchange takes longer than this many milliseconds.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Login password. Write-only on the API (encrypted at rest, never returned), so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. A `{{vault.KEY}}` reference is supported.
- `port` (Number) Port. Defaults to `25`.
- `protocol` (String) `Smtp`, `Imap` or `Pop3`. Defaults to `Smtp`.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to this monitor. Requires the SLA monitoring feature. When omitted the monitor keeps whatever it has, which on create is the tenant's default SLA profile if one is set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags surfaced in filters and SGL queries. Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls consecutive-failure logic.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Check timeout in seconds.
- `tls_mode` (String) `None`, `StartTls` or `Implicit`. Defaults to `StartTls`. A login is refused over a plaintext connection.
- `username` (String) Optional login user (SMTP AUTH PLAIN, IMAP LOGIN or POP3 USER/PASS).
- `validate_certificate` (Boolean) Fail on an invalid TLS certificate. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether a password is stored.
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `last_check_status` (String) Status of the last check (`Success`, `Warning`, `Critical`, ...), or null.
- `status` (String) Current monitor status (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_mail_monitor.relay mon_mail_001
```
